description: Editability matrix of the workbook template (#420): the cells a user may change in normal use, and what else each protected sheet allows (sorting, filtering where the template has an AutoFilter, inserting rows, opening and closing row groups). Every other cell is locked, except on a sheet of the role Working, which is never protected. tools/check_workbook_protection.py checks the template and the PROTECT_ constants of CORE_Config against it.

Params.role: Run configuration and reference regulatory parameters
Params.notes: AsOfDate, ReportingCcy, Regime, the day-count convention (the days of the conventional year) and the Calendar, the FX table, with rows below it for added currencies, and the table of closing days at its right are configuration. Every other value is a reference regulatory parameter, changed only after a maintenance unlock; a run on changed values stays WHAT-IF, except DaycountConvention and IRBucketOffset, conventions that do not change the run class (YearConvention and Calendar do not either).

Import_NettingSets.notes: The staged values; the CSV line column and the metadata stay locked.

Import_Trades.notes: The staged values; the CSV line column and the metadata stay locked.

Reconciliation.notes: Never protected (#720): the user sorts, filters and annotates the reconciliation. The run still writes the table.

ReconSummary.notes: Formulas only: the sums and counts per measure of the two reconciliation sheets, which follow their filters.
